resources.string: Open-source protocol research confirmed the MTTL local controller commands. Outlet controls activate only after a compatible strip identifies itself to this phone on TCP 10086; validation on each physical revision is still required.
Rooms, devices, automation, energy and direct local control from one platform.

Primary remote mode while FG Cloud is on hold. No FG VPS or monthly cloud service is required.
Private ZeroTier IP of controller phone / router gateway
Phone mode: install ZeroTier on the FG Machines Link controller phone. Enter that phone’s private ZeroTier IP; FG Link will use local API port 18086.

Router gateway mode: ZeroTier runs on the router. Enter the router’s ZeroTier IP. Forward TCP 18086 only from the ZeroTier interface to the controller phone’s LAN IP; no ZeroTier Managed Route is required. The app never flashes the router.
